2609.31430.title: Compress What You See, Not What You Say: Anchored Context Distillation for Latent-Observation Software Engineering Agents
2609.31430.paper_summary: Tool observations dominate the context of software-engineering agents, making long interaction histories costly to maintain. Existing context compression methods can discard information needed by later actions, while adapting agents to soft-token representations can compromise their original behavior. To reduce context while preserving action-critical information and agent behavior, we combine Latent Observations, Hard Actions (LOHA), a context layout that separates compressed history from text needed for exact reference, with Anchored Context Distillation (ACD), a training method that enables latent reading while constraining behavioral drift. LOHA compresses older tool observations into soft tokens while retaining the agent's own turns and the last K observations in text, providing compact access to historical information and exact access to recent content. To enable the agent to use this representation, ACD distills the base model's full-text predictions into the latent view while anchoring its behavior on plain-text inputs to the same base model. On SWE-bench Verified, K=3 reduces context per call by 43% for Qwen3-4B and 57% for SWE-Master-4B-RL, with resolve rates of 12.1% and 21.8% versus 14.5% and 27.5% for their uncompressed bases. A single-run recency sweep reaches 14.4% and 23.0% at K=8, with larger windows generally favoring task performance over compression. Under a 32K-token limit, Qwen3 with K=3 resolves 21.1% of a 199-instance subset versus 11.1% for the same adapted agent using full text. In concurrent single-GPU serving, it achieves 1.9 times that full-text agent's instance throughput.
2609.31430.paper_summary_zh: 工具觀察主導了軟體工程代理的背景，使得長期的互動歷史維護成本高昂。現有的上下文壓縮方法可能會丟棄後續行動所需的信息，而將代理適應於軟標記表示可能會妨礙其原始行為。為了在保留行動關鍵信息和代理行為的同時減少上下文，我們結合了潛在觀察、硬性行動（LOHA），這是一種將壓縮歷史與需要精確引用的文本分開的上下文佈局，與錨定上下文蒸餾（ACD），這是一種在限制行為漂移的同時使潛在閱讀成為可能的訓練方法。LOHA將較舊的工具觀察壓縮為軟標記，同時保留代理自己的回合和文本中的最後K個觀察，提供對歷史信息的緊湊訪問和對最近內容的精確訪問。為了使代理能夠使用這種表示，ACD將基礎模型的全文本預測蒸餾到潛在視圖中，同時將其行為錨定於對同一基礎模型的純文本輸入。在SWE-bench Verified上，K=3使Qwen3-4B每次調用的上下文減少43%，SWE-Master-4B-RL減少57%，其解決率分別為12.1%和21.8%，而未壓縮基礎的解決率為14.5%和27.5%。單次運行的近期掃描在K=8時達到14.4%和23.0%，較大的窗口通常更有利於任務性能而非壓縮。在32K標記限制下，Qwen3在K=3時對199個實例子集的解決率為21.1%，而同一適應代理使用全文本的解決率為11.1%。在並行單GPU服務中，其實例吞吐量達到全文本代理的1.9倍。
